name: aifeed
description: Signed content permissions for AI agents: verify a site's AIFeed manifest (Ed25519 + DNS anchor), fetch token-budgeted markdown, and decide whether a use such as retrieval, training, or quoting is allowed.

description_i18n.en: Signed content permissions for AI agents: verify a site's AIFeed manifest (Ed25519 + DNS anchor), fetch token-budgeted markdown, and decide whether a use such as retrieval, training, or quoting is allowed.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 AI 智能体的签名内容许可：验证站点的 AIFeed manifest（Ed25519 + DNS 锚点）、按 token 预算抓取 markdown，并判断检索、训练、引用等用途是否被允许。

allow_private.title: Allow loopback URLs
allow_private.description: Set to 1 to allow http:// loopback origins during local testing (default 0).
